inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani in-patient cover

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures per IRDAI standard

ayush_coverage.notes: Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy

no_claim_bonus_notes: 5% cumulative bonus per claim-free year, max 50% of base SI
room_rent_capping: Up to 2% of Sum Insured per day, max Rs 5,000 per day
icu_capping: Up to 5% of Sum Insured per day, max Rs 10,000 per day
copayment_trigger_notes: Mandatory 5% co-payment on all admissible claims (IRDAI standard for Arogya Sanjeevani)
permanent_exclusions: Specified disease/procedure 24-month waiting (cataract, hernia, joint replacement etc.)
Breach of law with criminal intent
Health hydros / spas / nature cure clinics
Maternity (incl ectopic - per standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani text)
notable_exclusions_summary: IRDAI standard Arogya Sanjeevani product. Mandatory 5% co-pay on all claims. Room rent capped at 2% of SI/day (max Rs 5,000), ICU at 5% of SI/day (max Rs 10,000). Cumulative bonus 5%/year up to 50% cap. No restoration, NCB, or restoration benefits beyond standard.
claim_process_summary: Cashless at network hospitals or reimbursement. Standard IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani claim process. 30-day free-look. 15-day TAT for settlement after document submission.
